integrity.proof_scope: Symbolic proof of normal-form completeness and cyclic-group counting; finite samples and symbolic identity checks supplement the proof.
integrity.source_normal_form_note: The cubic term in the e7 coordinate of the image of e2 in source equation (6.2) needs a minus sign; the corrected form is proved and checked against all 64 multiplication identities.

scientific_limitations: Only the specific eight-dimensional non-Lie right Leibniz algebra with the stated table is treated.
Finite fields must have characteristic greater than three; the statement does not extend to characteristic two or three as given.
Fixed-point-free means the automorphism has no nonzero fixed vector, not that every nonidentity power is fixed-point-free.
Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Fixed-point-free automorphisms of the eight-dimensional class-five Leibniz algebra
